description: Use this when someone asks about a Singapore property agent (salesperson) by name or CEA registration number, such as R028241G, including an agent asking what Homejourney shows about them, or wants agents who work in an area or at an agency. The query searches names and CEA numbers only: for agents in an area, such as an HDB seller in Tampines, pass area, alone or with agency. Returns matching agents on CEA's register with their agency, CEA number, Homejourney listing count, public profile URL and whether they hold the "Verified, replies fast" signal (credibility), whose agents come first among equally good name matches; then, with an area, agents with the most CEA-recorded deals there in the last three years come first, then those with the latest deal, each with their sales and rentals there and their latest deal month. Pass deal_type sale for a seller or buyer, so agents rank by their sales there, or rental for a landlord or tenant; without it every deal counts, and most HDB agent deals are rentals. Pass property_type to rank them by their deals in one kind of home there, such as landed for a landed home seller in D10. For a CEA number, or a name only one agent matches, it also returns the profile: transactions CEA records for them, their top areas and their public Homejourney listings, whose ids get_listing_details reads. Never returns contact details; send the user to the profile URL. Needs no sign-in.

agency.description: The agency's full name as CEA registers it, in any case, such as PropNex Realty Pte. Ltd. (a match's agency), or a featured agency's short name, such as PropNex, ERA or Huttons.

area.description: An HDB town (TAMPINES, ANG MO KIO) or private district (D01 to D28), or a place a district names, such as Orchard; lists agents with CEA-recorded transactions there.

deal_type.description: With an area: rank its agents by their sales there (sale: for a seller or buyer) or their rentals there (rental: for a landlord or tenant). Leave out to count every deal.

property_type.description: With an area: count only the agents' CEA-recorded deals in that kind of home there (hdb, condo, ec for executive condominiums, or landed for landed and strata landed houses). Leave out to count every kind.

query.description: The agent's name, or their CEA registration number. Never an area or agency.

name: search_agents

agency.description: The agency the agents are filtered by, from its full CEA name or a featured agency short name such as PropNex.

featured.description: Whether it is one of the agent directory's featured agencies.

options.description: When an agency that is not featured finds no agent: the featured agencies it could mean, else every featured agency. Pass one as agency.

value.description: The CEA-registered agency name searched, such as PROPNEX REALTY PTE. LTD.

area.description: The area the agents are filtered by: the area input, or the query when it names only an area and no agent.

value.description: The area input value, such as TAMPINES or D15.

areaRecentTotal.description: With an area: how many of `total` have a deal there since areaDeals.since. The rest dealt there only before it and come last.

areaDeals.description: With an area: the agent's CEA-recorded deals there (HDB in a town, private in a district, or only propertyType's kind of home when set) since `since`, which order the results, most first.

count.description: The deals counted: sales or rentals as dealType says, else both.

latestMonth.description: The month of the agent's latest deal there of the kind counted, such as 2026-09.

sales.description: Resales, new sales and sub-sales there.

since.description: The month counting starts, such as 2023-10.

credibility.description: The "Verified, replies fast" signal: a Singpass-verified CEA registration, a live listing its owner consented to, and a median first reply within a day over at least 3 viewing requests from the last 30 days. Earned agents come first among equally good name matches. Payment never earns it. Absent when it could not be read.

typicalReplyMinutes.description: When earned: their typical first reply to a viewing request, in minutes, as their page's "Usually replies within" line says.

dealType.description: With an area: the kind of deal that ordered its agents. Absent when every deal counted.

profile.description: The full profile; present when the query is a CEA number or one agent matches.

agentNextStep.description: For the agent themselves: how to verify with Singpass to get their viewing requests and add a photo, bio and languages, and, when other portals send listings under their CEA number, that they can then take those over for free and fix them. Null once they claimed the profile.

areas.description: HDB towns and private districts with the most recorded transactions.

claimedOnHomejourney.description: Whether the agent has verified and claimed this profile on Homejourney, as their page shows.

credibility.description: The "Verified, replies fast" signal: a Singpass-verified CEA registration, a live listing its owner consented to, and a median first reply within a day over at least 3 viewing requests from the last 30 days. Earned agents come first among equally good name matches. Payment never earns it. Absent when it could not be read.

typicalReplyMinutes.description: When earned: their typical first reply to a viewing request, in minutes, as their page's "Usually replies within" line says.

earliestTransactionMonth.description: The month of the agent's first recorded transaction, such as 2017-01; recordedTransactions and areas count from it.

latestTransactionMonth.description: The month of the agent's latest recorded transaction, such as 2026-07.

listings.description: Up to 10 of their public Homejourney listings. Their listings at one address or in one development are one item, whose listingCluster counts them and names the others.

bedrooms.description: The home's bedrooms; for a let room, read room.

listingCluster.description: This item stands for listingCount of their listings at one address (scope address) or in one development (scope development): itself and otherListingIds, priced minPrice to maxPrice. Absent for a listing no other joins. They may be different homes, since an agent can list two flats in one block.

price.description: SGD; monthly rent for a rental.

room.description: For a rental that lets a master room, common room or bed space: the room itself. Null for a whole home, a studio or a sale.

label.description: Master room, Common room or Bed space.

squareFeet.description: The room's own size; null when not stated.

recordedTransactions.description: Transactions CEA records for the agent.

propertyType.description: With an area: the kind of home whose deals ordered its agents. Absent when every kind counted.

queryNamesAgency.description: A featured agency the query names. Without a matching agency, the query was searched as agent names, not as that agency's agents.

featured.description: Whether it is one of the agent directory's featured agencies.

options.description: When an agency that is not featured finds no agent: the featured agencies it could mean, else every featured agency. Pass one as agency.

value.description: The CEA-registered agency name searched, such as PROPNEX REALTY PTE. LTD.

queryNamesArea.description: An area the query names, as the private district for a condo, EC or landed home. Without a matching area, the query was searched as agent names, not as that area.

value.description: The area input value, such as TAMPINES or D15.

queryNamesDealType.description: With queryNamesArea: the kind of deal the query names, to pass as deal_type with that area.

queryNamesPropertyType.description: With queryNamesArea: the kind of home the query names, to pass as property_type with that area.

replyText.description: This reply as text: what it found, the next step, and every id or link a follow-up call needs. Read it before answering the user.

resultReason.description: Set when no agent matches, or the area is not an HDB town or private district.

townDistricts.description: Set when a condo, EC or landed search named an HDB town: area is the first private district covering it, since CEA records those deals by district; districts lists every one that does.

value.description: The area input value, such as TAMPINES or D15.

town.description: The HDB town the area input named.

value.description: The area input value, such as TAMPINES or D15.

title: Look up a property agent
